result.notes: Both PLP pages timed out waiting for networkidle (30s) but rendered content and captured errors successfully during the timeout period. All observed console errors are pre-existing platform noise: React framework warnings (getServerSnapshot caching, defaultProps deprecation), DataCloud sandbox DNS resolution failures (c360a.salesforce.com unreachable in dev), and Einstein recommendations 403 responses (sandbox returns 403). No Quick View feature code exists yet so no feature-specific errors are expected. The 403 Forbidden errors on load resources are likely Einstein recommendation API calls which are known to fail in sandbox/dev environments.

result.summary: Implemented PLP Quick View modal feature with 6 new files and 2 modified overrides
key_decisions: Reused ProductView with showDeliveryOptions={false} — no pickup/ship-to-store UI
ProductView opens AddToCartModal internally — no duplicate mounting
QuickViewProvider wraps route children inside BaseApp to access AddToCartModalProvider context
isMounted pattern on trigger prevents pre-hydration click race
Modal body gated on isOpen — no SSR detail fetches
result.ssr_safety: All checked: no unguarded window/document access, no Date.now/Math.random in render, no raw fetch calls

deviations: UT-BODY-011/012: Implementation uses unified addItemToNewOrExistingBasket helper instead of separate createBasket/addItemToBasket
UT-BODY-010: AddToCartModal opened by ProductView internally (returns truthy), not by body calling onOpen directly
quick-view-add-to-cart-btn testid not in implementation - tested via mock ProductView
UT-A11Y-001: Chakra overrides aria-labelledby; test verifies heading id exists inside dialog

fixes_applied.bug: modal.getByRole('radio') matched ALL radios (color+size). Clicking the second radio hit a SIZE swatch that doesn't change the gallery image.
fixes_applied.fix: Scoped to color radiogroup: modal.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: /color/i }).getByRole('radio')

fixes_applied.bug: Flat iteration of all radios clicked the first non-disabled one — the already-selected color swatch. Size remained unselected, so ProductView blocked add-to-cart.
fixes_applied.fix: Added selectCompleteVariation() helper that iterates each radiogroup independently and selects first non-disabled option in each.

fixes_applied.bug: Asserted toBeDisabled() on ATC button, but base ProductView validates on click (shows validation message) rather than disabling the button.
fixes_applied.fix: Click ATC with incomplete variation, assert modal stays open and add-to-cart confirmation modal does NOT appear.
Changed to sf-product-tile-{id} testid pattern which exists in the DOM.

result.self_review_greps: All passed: no networkidle, no waitForTimeout, no tautological titles, dismissOverlays present, awaitHydrated present, consoleErrors asserted in all tests.

attempts.errorSummary:
Fixed 2 code-defects (quick-view-add-to-cart-btn testid missing, close button aria-label removed). E2E-004b now passes. 3 remaining failures are test-code bugs:

E2E-002: Test uses modal.getByRole('radio') which gets ALL radios (color+size). Clicks second radio expecting image change, but second radio is a SIZE swatch that doesn't affect the image. Fix: scope to color radiogroup.

E2E-003: Test's variation selection iterates all radios and clicks first non-disabled one (already-selected color swatch). Size remains unselected. ProductView's validateAndShowError() prevents add-to-cart, modal stays open. Fix: iterate through each radiogroup separately to select complete variation.

E2E-006: Test expects ATC button to be disabled before variation selection, but base ProductView validates on click (shows "Please select all your options above") rather than disabling the button. Fix: assert validation message appears on click instead of asserting disabled state.
